paragraph: The meme shows a man jumping off a plane with a parachute, while The text says "parachutes aren't 100% effective either, but wearing one is a damn good idea", and "anti-vaxxers keep saying dumb things like "vaccines aren't 100% effective, so they are useless". Due to the similar wording of these two sentences combined with the image shown, we can infer that the meme is trying to compare anti-vaxxers refusing vaccines with people jumping off an airplane without a parachute. Since we already know that jumping off an airplane without a parachute is stupid, we can conclude that the meme criticizes anti-vaxxers as stupid.

The meme shows the famous actor Morgan Freeman appearing to say the text , "definition of stupid: knowing the truth, seeing the truth, but still believing in TRUDEAU". We recall that Morgan Freeman is an actor known for saying the truth in movies, which means it must be true that people who believe in Trudeau are stupid. Since a leader’s supporters are the ones that believe them, and Trudeau must have done something stupid to have made supporting him so stupid, we can conclude that this meme criticizes Justin Trudeau and Trudeau's supporters.

The meme show Justin Trudeau and Pierre Trudeau dancing in a similar manner, while the text says "Oh look, acting like a moron is genetic". From this, we can see that the meme is trying to point out something shared among Justin and Pierre Trudeau. Since we know that Pierre Trudeau and Justin Trudeau are genetically related, we can reason that this thing being shared is “acting like a moron. Thus, we can conclude that the meme criticizes Justin Trudeau and Pierre Trudeau as stupid.

The meme depicts Joe Biden with a confused look and soiled pants. Since looking confused and peeing yourself are commonly used to depict weakness, we can reason that the meme is trying to depict Joe Biden as weak. Also, the text states, "after first debate with trump". Since Joe Biden debated Donald Trump during the 2020 Presidential Election, we can reason that the meme is trying to compare Biden against Trump. Thus, the meme mocks Joe Biden as weak compared to Trump.

The meme depicts Bill Gates holding a vaccine, while also stating that “Bill Gates has a secret eugenics plan to depopulate the world through vaccines”. Since secret eugenics plans to depopulate the world through vaccines are comically evil and lack a clear motive, we can reason that the meme is depicting conspiracy theories about Bill Gates and vaccines are extreme and nonsensical. We recall that the straw man fallacy attempts to refute an argument by depicting it as radical and ridiculous. We can therefore understand that the meme is using the straw man fallacy to try and refute conspiracy theories about Bill Gates and vaccines. Additionally, the meme further states, "because all evil villains announce their murderous plans in ted talk presentations". This refers to TED Talks, which are a series of popular talks by experts in various fields. We know that in popular media, evil villains try to hide their evil plans. This is a contradiction, meaning that this text is sarcastic, and therefore Bill Gates does not actually have a murderous plan. Thus, we can conclude that the meme mocks conspiracy theories about Bill Gates and Vaccination are stupid.

The meme depicts Mark Zuckerburg while the text states, "get in loser we're deleting meme pages for "hate speech" but leaving up kiddie porn and videos of people dying". We remember that Mark Zuckerburg is the CEO of Facebook and Facebook moderates content posted to it by banning offensive content such as hate speech, child pornography, and graphic content, so this meme's topic is likely related to Facebook's moderation policy. We also remember that child pornography is universally considered evil, while memes are generally considered harmless, and that quotation marks around a word express doubt about it. Thus, it is contradictory for Facebook to delete memes which the author doubts are truely "hate speech" while being OK with child porn and graphic violence. Since groups or people generally have a reason for actions that would otherwise seem contradictory, we understand that the meme is trying to imply that Facebook has a agenda to delete these memes. We recall that Conservatives has accused Facebook and other social media platforms of being biased against them in the past, so we can conclude that the meme accuses Facebook of being biased against conservatives.

The text states "can I get a fuck Trump" and The image depicts a women holding her hands up in prayer. From this, we recall that People pray about things they have strong feelings for. We therefore understand that the meme is associating these strong feelings with the message and the text, and can conclude that the meme insults Trump.

The meme states, "just when you think democrat ethics, honesty, integrity, and behavior have hit rock bottom, they blast through the rock bed... to a never-before-seen depth.", which is a reference to the phrase "Hitting Rock Bottom", used to describe when someone has reached the lowest point in their life. Visually, the meme depicts an underground explosion, similar to the Explosives used in mining operations to break through rock. This image is associating the action of “being below rock bottom" with Democrat’s ethics, honesty, integrity, and behavior. We can recall the definition of “hitting rock bottom” to conclude that the meme is claiming that Democrat's ethics, honesty, integrity, and behavior are at an unprecedentedly low level. Since we also know that ethics, honesty, integrity, and behavior are all used to judge moral character, , we can conclude that the meme criticizes Democrats as evil.

The text states "unvaccinated body:*exists* near extinct and easily preventable diseases: It's free real estate". Since it’s generally easy for someone to enter and exit a house, we can then say that the meme is trying to convey that unvaccinated people are more susceptible to near extinct and easily preventable disease Given that we also know Unvaccinated people intentionally refuse protection from disease in the form of vaccines and Contracting disease is generally considered unpleasant and something to be avoided, we can conclude that : the meme mocks unvaccinated people as stupid.

When text states, "the phrase black lives matter suggests racial superiority. It excludes the importance of anybody else's life. Since the winner of this election is elected by the voters, , the meme recommends voters to vote for Trump.

The text states, "Our elders were called to war to save lives. We are being called to sit on the couch to save theirs. We can do this" while depicting a couch. Since we also know that sitting on the couch is very easy, we know that the current generation doesn't ahve to endure very much hardship to save lives. In conclusion, we can say that the meme accuses Bernie Sanders of being as bad as Hitler.

We also recall that 2020 was at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, so the meme is trying to draw comparisons between people taking shelter in train tunnels during the blitz and people being force to quarantine and social distance during COVID.
